scheme_name: Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Tuition Fees for Enhancement of Skill
other_conditions: The training institute must have at least 5 years of experience in skill development or relevant industry.
The training program must be industry‑responsive and recognized by skill development bodies.
The first training batch must commence within 3 months of the sanction order.
A minimum of 10 trainees per batch must complete the training and certification process.
Candidates must not have availed similar government assistance for the same course.
The training duration should not exceed 6 months unless specified by authorities.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to ₹15,000 for training programs, with full fee coverage for BPL, physically handicapped, SC, ST, SEBC and women candidates, and 75% assistance for other eligible candidates.
